title: Seating System
description: Cellular automaton on a seating layout with adjacent and line-of-sight neighbor rules.
writeup:
## Approach

A Game-of-Life-style simulation on a seating chart. Each round, seats change based on their neighbors. Simulate until the layout stabilizes.

## Part 1

Use the 8 immediately adjacent cells as neighbors. An empty seat (`L`) becomes occupied if no neighbors are occupied. An occupied seat (`#`) becomes empty if 4 or more neighbors are occupied. Floor tiles (`.`) never change. Repeat until no changes occur.

## Part 2

Instead of immediate neighbors, cast rays in all 8 directions and find the first seat (not floor) in each direction. The tolerance threshold also increases to 5 occupied visible seats before a seat empties. This models people looking further but being slightly more tolerant of crowding.
